# Local time-zone fixtures

Eight unchanged TZif files from macOS /usr/share/zoneinfo (IANA2026e-rearguard).
The accompanying tzdata.zi declares: "This zic input file is in the public domain."
IANA database licensing: https://data.iana.org/time-zones/tz-link.html#license
These are deterministic test data, not the production system time-zone database.
Exact source names and byte hashes are in provenance.json.
